statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => ¬ o n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ)) * (((Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ (1:ℝ)/3 < K n ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))).card:ℝ) / (Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2) ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 一般分母及偶分母的加权共振分子密度趋零
plain_statement.en: Vanishing weighted density for remaining and even denominators

brief.zh: 奇分母长周期可从二阶矩入手。偶分母写成 2ᵛr，分别处理初始 v 步和奇数部分；权重中的 q/Q 记录旧主弧剔除的峰心。
brief.en: Use the second moment for long odd periods. For q=2ᵛr separate the transient from the odd orbit. The q/Q factor accounts for the removed original core.
